title.narrative: Sport 4 Inclusion

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to empower young people to identify and fight discrimination through sport-based activities in Kosovo.

The Specific Objectives (SOs) of this action are:


Strengthen the capacity of local civil society organisations (CSOs) in mobilising and empowering youth against discriminations and to build resilient and inclusive communities.

Raise awareness of young people in Kosovo, with respect to gender equality, on promotion of common values and social cohesion and enable them to carry out collaborative projects that promote these values.
